title: Wave 4 notice-on-a-missed-target harness: environment, fixture keys, missed-target comparison, evidence and gate are not specified
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md §R7.3 and §R9; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md RWB-E7-014 lines 12636-12714
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: RWB-ITG-E7014-ITG needs the harness environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic partner, instruction, case and notice keys, the stub answer shapes for the seven consumed contracts, the conduct of the missed-target comparison against the named rule version, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate; no source gives any of them. The rule version, the contractual target, the score, the notice type and the cure period length are data the fixture must name, and none of them is stated either.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E7-014 (lines 12636-12714) gives the story, AC1 and AC2, the four data entities with their field IDs, the two partner-portal endpoints, the screens, the rights, the three messages and TC-E7-014-01 to TC-E7-014-04, and states no environment, base host, fixture, stub answer, comparison, evidence format or gate; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line 144 (FEAT-PRM-11), line 141 (FEAT-PRM-08) and line 135 (FEAT-PRM-02) name the feature, the scorecard and the reference data but no harness detail; Arch v5 slides 15, 17, 20, 25, 31 and 41 to 44 and Temporal and Drools design slides 13, 25 and 26 name owners, topics and workflows but no test environment; Template and Rules v1 §R7.3 lists the fill order and none of its sources holds these values.
proposed: Agree at the wave 4 entry check the SIT base hosts, the fixture layout and the synthetic partner, instruction, case and notice keys, the stub answer shapes, how the score is compared with the contractual target of the named rule version, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate; record them in the harness README so the fixture stays data and no business value is hard-coded.

title: Wave 4 conduct-check harness: environment, fixtures, sample size and method, conduct-trigger hook, evidence and gate are not specified
source: Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, RWB-E7-016 lines 12800-12877; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line 146 (FEAT-PRM-13); Architecture v5 slides 17, 27, 41 to 44; Template and Rules v1 §R7.3 and §R9
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: RWB-ITG-E7016-ITG needs the harness environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic partner and instruction keys, the stub answer shapes for the six consumed contracts, the sample size and the sampling method, the source of the contacts and complaints the sample reads, the fixture hook for the conduct trigger that has no published operation, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate. No source gives any of them, so one placeholder is used in sections 3, 12.8, 13 and 15 and no business value is invented.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E7-016 (lines 12800-12877) gives the story, AC1 and AC2, three data entities with their BR Field IDs, two partner-portal endpoints, two screens, the right lists and four test cases, and no environment, fixture, sample method, answer shape, evidence or gate; the FSD row FEAT-PRM-13 (line 146) and FEAT-PRM-08 (line 141) name the feature and its predecessor only; Arch v5 slides 17, 27 and 41 to 44 name the owners, the decision ledger and the rule promote job but no test environment; the WP line for RWB-ITG-E7016-ITG carries no value for it.
proposed: Agree the SIT base hosts, the fixture layout and synthetic keys, the stub answer shapes, the sample size and sampling method with the source of the sampled contacts and complaints, the S9 fixture hook that fires the conduct trigger, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate at the wave 4 entry check, and record them in the harness configuration; every fixture value stays data and no business value is hard-coded.

title: Wave 4 integration harness for the extra costs on a held asset has no specified environment, fixture set, claim shape or evidence gate
source: Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, RWB-E7-017 lines 12881-12960; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line 147 (FEAT-PRM-14) and line 73 (FEAT-AST-07); Architecture v5 slides 17, 19, 41 and 44; Template and Rules v1 §R9
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: The legacy story names the held asset, the partner, the instruction, the decision log, the two partner-portal operations and the messages, but no source states the harness environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic asset, partner, instruction and case keys, the stub answer shapes, the shape of the additional-cost claim, where the cost approval is recorded in S9 and in S5, the evidence format and retention, or the pass or fail gate. The Ownership Map publishes no cost-approval operation and no owned cost table for the feature, so the approval point is carried as a placeholder rather than invented.
evidence: RWB-E7-017 lines 12881-12960 give the story, AC1 and AC2, the four data entities, POST /api/recovery/v1/partner/instructions/{instructionId}/results, GET /api/recovery/v1/partner/instructions, SCR-34 and SCR-35, the two Partner portal right rows, three messages and TC-E7-017-01 to TC-E7-017-04, with no environment, base host, fixture, answer shape, evidence or gate; FEAT-PRM-14 (line 147) and FEAT-AST-07 (line 73) name the feature and the system of record only; Arch v5 slides 17, 19, 41 and 44 and Temporal design slides 13, 25 and 26 name the owners, the workflows and JOB-19 but no test configuration; ownership.json holds no cost table and no cost-approval operation.
proposed: Agree at the wave 4 entry check the SIT base hosts, the fixture layout and synthetic keys, the stub answer shapes, the shape of the additional-cost claim, where the cost approval is recorded in S9 and in S5, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate, and record them in the harness configuration rather than in code.

title: Wave 4 panel-change integration harness: environment, base hosts, fixture layout, synthetic keys, stub answer shapes, effective date, reference-row shape, evidence and gate are not specified
source: Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, RWB-E8-012 lines 15579-15660; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line 180 (FEAT-ADM-07) and line 135 (FEAT-PRM-02); Business Requirements Program v4 lines 269, 153, 279, 430 and 435; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 lines 430, 442 and 443; Architecture v5 slides 14, 17, 20, 27 and 41 to 44; Temporal and Drools design slides 13, 15, 19 and 25; Template and Rules v1 §R7.3 and §R9
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: RWB-ITG-E8012-ITG needs the SIT environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic panel and partner keys and the reference load key, the stub answer shapes for the seven consumed operations and the panel-change fixture, the effective date the run uses, the shape of the panel reference row, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate; no source gives any of them.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E8-012 (lines 15579-15660) names the panel change, AC1 and AC2, the four data entities, the two rule-version paths, the two admin screens, the rights and the messages, and no environment, fixture, effective date, reference-row shape, evidence or gate; the Ownership Map publishes no panel-change operation of its own; the Arch v5 extract and the Temporal and Drools design name the owners, the workflow and the 00:01 promotion but no test environment.

title: Wave 4 contract-end and recall harness: environment, fixture hook, open-case definition and evidence gate are not specified
source: Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, RWB-E7-015 lines 12718-12797; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line 145 (FEAT-PRM-12); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-UNI-26 line 430 and R-UNI-39 line 443; Architecture v5 slide 17; Template and Rules v1 §R9
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: RWB-ITG-E7015-ITG needs the SIT environment and base hosts, the fixture layout and the synthetic partner, instruction and case keys, the stub answer shapes of the six consumed contracts, the fixture hook that stands in for the unpublished contract-end action and its answer, the definition of "open case" the recall enumerates, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate; no source gives any of them. The Ownership Map publishes no operation for the contract-end and recall action, so the harness has to sequence it through a fixture hook that is itself unspecified.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E7-015 (lines 12718-12797) gives the story, AC1 and AC2, four data entities, two partner operations, two screens, the two Partner portal rights, three messages and four test cases, and no environment, fixture, hook, open-case definition, evidence or gate detail; Arch v5 slide 17 and slides 41 to 44 name the owners, the topic and the workflow but no test environment; the Ownership Map lists /partners, /partner/instructions and /partner/instructions/{instructionId}/results for S9 and no operation for the contract end; Template and Rules v1 §R7.3 fill order has no source for these values.
proposed: Agree the SIT base hosts, the fixture layout and synthetic keys, the stub answer shapes, the contract-end fixture hook and its answer, the definition of "open case" the recall enumerates, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate at the wave 4 entry check, and record them in the harness README; the fixture values stay data and no business value is hard-coded.
